'''Chapter 1010''' is titled "Color of the Supreme King".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "[[Charlotte Pudding|Pudding]] putting in eye drops" by PN Mattsu.

==Short Summary==
[[Kaidou]] attacks [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] to stop him from attacking [[Prometheus]], and [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] teleports Zoro away from the Emperor's attack. This allows Prometheus to fly down and rescue [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] right before she lands in the ocean, and [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] and [[Killer]] head to confront Big Mom while the others keep fighting Kaidou.

Zoro, having sustained grievous wounds from blocking the Emperors' ''Hakai'' attack, puts all his remaining energy into a final ''[[Three Sword Style/Nine Sword Style|Nine Sword Style]]'' strike that manages to give Kaidou a notable scar on his chest, shocking Kaidou, suspected that the swordsman is using [[Haki/Supreme King Haki|Supreme King Haki]]. Kaidou immobilizes Zoro and Law with ''Raimei Hakke'', but Luffy then regains consciousness and confronts the Emperor. Noting that the advanced [[Haki/Armament Haki|Armament Haki]] applications he learned had not succeeded in inflicting real harm against Kaidou, Luffy realizes that one can also infuse objects with Supreme King Haki, a technique Kaidou is capable of. With this revelation, Luffy starts putting his own Supreme King Haki to use and successfully hits Kaidou from afar with immense power, saying Law and Zoro can go back down below while he takes on the Emperor alone.

==Long Summary==
[[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] cries for [[Zeus]] to save her but he can't due to being trapped in Kid's box. [[Prometheus]] attempts to save her but [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]]'s continuous attacking prevents Prometheus from moving. Law is left in disbelief seeing Zoro still able to move after the [[Four Emperors|Emperors]]' last attack. [[Kaidou]] calls Big Mom pathetic but he charges for Zoro demanding he release Prometheus. [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]], however, uses his [[Ope Ope no Mi|Devil Fruit powers]] to switch places with him, where he then uses '''Injection Shot''' on Kaidou's throat. He uses '''Curtain''' to shield himself, but Kaidou blows him away while saying his powers are annoying. This does give Prometheus and [[Napoleon]] the opening needed to rush to Big Mom's aid, causing Zoro to ask why he did that. Law answers that his plans aren't worth one of them dying, but [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] says that they already succeeded in separating the two as both him and [[Killer]] decide to take on Big Mom themselves.

Prometheus is able to catch Big Mom, who thanks him for saving her. She also wonders what happened with Zeus as Prometheus says he is always holding them back. He then asks Big Mom for a favor as Kid and Killer notice the clouds above swirling.

Back on the roof, Kaidou laughs at how [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] was glaring at him while unconscious like back in Bakura Town. He starts talking about different ways to maim him as Zoro tells Law that he has reached his limit so this next attack will be his last. He coats his swords in [[Haki/Armament Haki|Armament Haki]] and assumes his '''Ashura''' form while attacking him with '''[[Three Sword Style/Nine Sword Style#After the Timeskip|Ashura Bakkei: Moja no Tawamure]]'''.

Kaidou clutches his chest in pain while asking Zoro if he has [[Haki/Supreme King Haki|Supreme King Haki]]. Zoro doesn't know what he is talking about as he falls down, saying that he had hoped that attack would have brought Kaidou down to the ground. Kaidou, however, tells Zoro that his attack will definitely leave a scar on him. He raises his kanabo to attack as Law tries to help him avoid it. Kaidou tells him it is too late and blows the both of them away with '''Raimei Hakke'''. After defeating the two of them, Kaidou says that if they had joined him, they could have taken over the world together.

Suddenly, he hears Luffy tell him that they would never team up with him due to their friendship with the [[Nine Red Scabbards|samurai]]. He thinks back to [[Hyougoro]]'s training and his advice on [[Haki]] and admits all the attacks he used on Kaidou were shallow but [[Chapter 1009|after being struck with his kanabo]], Luffy realized the truth: Kaidou can infuse objects with Supreme King Haki. Kaidou laughs in confirmation as he charges at Luffy, revealing that only a select few powerful individuals can pull it off as he brings his club down on Luffy. However, Luffy, having worked out how to infuse Supreme King Haki into his limbs, blocks the attack with his foot without even touching it. He then charges for Kaidou and punches him in the gut again without touching him before delivering an uppercut that sends him flying and crashing down onto his back.

Law is left in disbelief that Luffy did damage without actually touching Kaidou. Luffy thanks both him and Zoro for covering him, but they can go back down to the castle. He declares that he can handle the rest and he will beat Kaidou no matter what.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Kaidou]] knocks out [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and attacks [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], allowing [[Prometheus]] to escape with [[Napoleon]].
**[[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] saves Zoro by [[Ope Ope no Mi|switching]] places with him and attacking Kaidou.
**[[Eustass Kid|Kid]] and [[Killer]] chase after [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]].
**Prometheus rescues Big Mom from falling into the ocean. He also asks for a favor from Big Mom.
**Kid and Killer notice something strange happening with [[Onigashima]]'s clouds.
*Zoro uses [[Three Sword Style/Nine Sword Style|Nine Sword Style]] and severely wounds Kaidou.
**This marks the first time Zoro used Nine Sword Style since the timeskip.
**Kaidou suspects Zoro possesses [[Haki/Supreme King Haki|Supreme King Haki]], but Zoro is unaware of what he is referring to.
*Kaidou defeats Zoro and Law.
*Luffy recovers and strikes Kaidou without making any [[Haki/Supreme King Haki#Infusion|physical contact]].
**Luffy realizes Kaidou can infuse his attacks with Supreme King Haki, and does the same.
**Luffy tells Law and Zoro they can leave the battle on the roof and head down.
